code:
pwd                  # print working directory: where am I right now?
ls                   # list all files and folders here
ls -la               # list everything including hidden files, with full details (size, owner, date)
cd projects          # change directory INTO the folder named "projects"
cd ..                # go UP one level to the parent folder
cd ~                 # jump directly to your home directory, no matter where you are
cd -                 # jump back to wherever you just were (like a browser Back button)
description: These seven commands print the working directory, list visible and hidden files, and move around the directory tree with cd.

steps.description: pwd prints your current working directory, ls lists the files and folders in it, and ls -la includes hidden files (whose names start with a dot) along with size, owner, and date.
cd projects enters the projects subfolder, cd .. moves up one level to the parent folder, cd ~ jumps to your home directory, and cd - returns to the previous directory.

title: Checking your current folder, listing files, and changing directories
